Name: Beard and Hair pack
Author: undare
Description:
[b][size=5]About
[/size]
[size=3](It always bothers me that "beards" are "accesories", so i can never use the [color=#9fc5e8]glasses [/color]option on my farmer)

Fully compatible with "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4808]Muscular Farmer Body[/url]"  (Used in the screenshots)
[/size]

[size=3]-This pack adds 24 new "[/size][color=#dbb0a7]Hairstyles[/color][size=3]". ([/size][color=#f6b26b]Vanilla Hairstyles [/color][size=3]remain the same)[/size]
[size=3]A combination of custom beards + vanilla hairstyles.
[/size](Works for the [color=#d5a6bd]female [/color]farmer)

[size=3]-To see/select them, just scroll the "[/size][color=#93c47d]Hair[/color][size=3]" option on the [/size][color=#f6b26b]character creation screen[/color][size=3],
(If you don´t have another "new" pack, it would be past number 74, or if you cycle with the left arrow, will be past number 0)
[/size]
[size=3]-There is an [/size][color=#8e7cc3][size=3]option [/size][/color][size=3]to change your look in an already on-going game. * Spoiler at the bottom *[/size]


[size=3]-Also this have support for [/size][color=#dd7e6b]Bodyhair [/color][size=3]and [/size][color=#b4a7d6]Tails [/color][size=3]on the config options.[/size]
[b][size=3](Some images and a text file were added to the file for easy referencing.)[/size][/b]


[size=3]/////////////////////////////////////////////////////[/size]
[size=5]Config Options [/size]

[size=3]2 ways to edit the config :[/size]

[size=3]-Config.json file is on this mod folder[/size]
[size=3]or[/size]
[size=3]-if you have Generic [/size][color=#e69138]Mod Config Menu[/color][size=3], you can edit it on the game start menu. (Gear icon bottom left)[/size]
[b][size=3]
[/size][/b]

[size=3]"[/size][color=#dd7e6b]BodyHair[/color][size=3]": "none, small, medium, mediumsoft, full"[/size]

[size=3]"[/size][color=#b4a7d6]Tails[/color][size=3]": [/size]"none, smalltail, mediumtail ,tipmedium"

[size=3]Both are default to "[/size][color=#9fc5e8]none[/color][size=3]"[/size]

[b][size=3]/////////////////////////////////////////////////////[/size][/b]

[size=5]Warning[/size]

[size=3]-! When changing bodyhair and/or tails, be aware that you need to restart the game to see the changes on the "Character creation screen" ![/size]
[/b]





[size=1]*With an affinity of 4hearts you can visit the Wizard basement on his tower, to change your look for a small fee.[/size]

Downloads.Description:
-24 new hairstyles
-4 bodyhair options
-3 tail options
